The face ``fixed`` (default: the largest planar face) stays where it is; the rest of the
sheet unfolds into its plane. With the K-factor the part was bent with, the result is the
blank it was bent from. For the flat pattern on the XY plane, with outline and bend lines,
use :func:`flat_pattern`.

signatures.text: raycast(origin: VectorLike | Axis, direction: VectorLike | Axis | None = None) -> list[Hit]

docs.summary: Where a ray meets this body's faces, nearest first: the exact points (``Hit``: point,
docs.remarks:
distance from the start, the face, its outward normal there).

The ray starts at ``origin`` and runs along ``direction`` (an axis or a vector); an axis
alone is a ray from its origin along its direction. Points behind the start are not
hits. A ray through an edge or a vertex hits once, a ray along a face where it enters
the face. ``hits[0]`` is what the ray sees first; ``len(hits)`` is odd from inside a
closed part.
